mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing carvedilol plasma concentrations and enhancing beta-blocking effects with potential for excessive bradycardia and hypotension.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., doxycycline, amoxicillin-clavulanate); if combination necessary, reduce carvedilol dose and adjust based on clinical response.
